# contabo_ptr_record (Data Source)

Look up the reverse DNS (PTR) record of an IP address assigned to your account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure your Contabo API credentials
provider "contabo" {
  oauth2_client_id     = "[your client id]"
  oauth2_client_secret = "[your client secret]"
  oauth2_user          = "[your username]"
  oauth2_pass          = "[your password]"
}

# Get the PTR record of an IP address
data "contabo_ptr_record" "example" {
  ip_address = "203.0.113.10"
}

output "ptr" {
  value = data.contabo_ptr_record.example.ptr
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_address` (String) The IPv4 or IPv6 address to look up.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier of the PTR record, which is the IP address.
- `ptr` (String) The host name the IP address resolves to.
- `ttl` (Number) The time to live of the PTR record in seconds.
